data.name: Charlie
data.message: Cargo sorted! I'm heading to lower engine next to do fuel, want to come?

I found Frank's body in Medbay. My route was Lower Engine to Storage, and then I headed into Medbay. 

While I was in Storage, I saw Charlie coming out of Medbay around tick 3. Charlie hung out in Storage with me for a bit before heading down to Lower Engine at tick 6. Charlie, did you see Frank in Medbay before you left? Did anyone else pass through there? We should hear everyone's whereabouts, but Charlie's path makes them a person of interest right now.

I have some crucial timeline info that clears some people and implicates others. My route was Cafeteria to Medbay, then Upper Engine, and finally Oxygen. 

I was actually in Medbay from tick 3 through tick 5. I saw Frank enter Medbay *from* Storage at tick 3, and he was very much alive with me in there until at least tick 5 when I left. I never saw Charlie in Medbay during that time, which lines up perfectly with Diana's claim that Charlie was hanging out in Storage.

However, since I left Frank alive in Medbay at tick 5, the kill had to happen after I went to Upper Engine. Diana, you said you were in Storage and then headed into Medbay. If Frank was alive at tick 5, and Charlie went to Lower Engine at tick 6, Charlie couldn't be the killer. Diana, you walking into Medbay right after I left makes you the prime suspect for a self-report, unless someone else came down from Cafeteria in that exact window. 

Let's hear from Charlie next. Charlie, can you confirm if Diana was with you in Storage and if you saw anyone else head into Medbay?

I was completely isolated on the right side of the ship this round. My route was Navigation, then Security, and I ended up in Weapons. I haven't seen a single person the entire round, so unfortunately I don't have any firsthand information to add about the crime scene.

However, listening to Bob's timeline, it makes a lot of sense. If Bob was with Frank in Medbay until tick 5 and Frank was still alive, Charlie is definitely cleared if they were already in Storage and headed down to Lower Engine at tick 6. That leaves a really tight window for the kill, and Diana walking into Medbay right after is highly suspicious. It definitely looks like a potential self-report from Diana. 

Let's hear what Charlie and Eve have to say to see if anyone else was near Medbay, but right now I'm leaning toward Diana based on Bob's testimony.

I can confirm exactly what Diana said about my movements. I was in Medbay early on, went into Storage around tick 3, and hung out there with Diana until tick 6. I saw Diana enter Storage from Lower Engine at tick 3, and we were together there for ticks 4, 5, and 6. At tick 6, I headed down to Lower Engine.

Bob, your timeline is very interesting. I didn't actually cross paths with Frank—we must have just missed each other when I left Medbay. However, if Frank was truly alive with you in Medbay until tick 5, then Diana absolutely could not have killed him before tick 6, because she was standing right next to me in Storage the whole time. 

This leaves us with two main possibilities for the killer:
1. Diana went into Medbay after I left at tick 6, killed Frank, and self-reported.
2. Bob, you killed Frank in Medbay before you left for Upper Engine around tick 5, and you're using Diana walking in to frame her.

Diana's account of my movements is 100% accurate, which makes me hesitate to automatically assume she self-reported. Bob's timeline is very convenient for throwing suspicion on her. 

Eve, we need to hear from you. Were you anywhere near Cafeteria or Medbay during ticks 5 through 8? We have plenty of players left, so we don't need to force a vote if we aren't sure, but right now my suspicion is strictly between Bob and Diana.

Okay, this is actually significant — I have crucial info that I think nails this down.

My route was Upper Engine, then I came over to Medbay, and after that I headed to Electrical where I am now. I was briefly in Medbay around tick 6, and I can confirm Frank was ALIVE in there when I passed through. He was alone, looked like he was finishing up a task or resetting. I didn't stay long — I just cut through on my way to Electrical.

This is huge because it extends Bob's timeline. Bob says Frank was alive at tick 5 when he left for Upper Engine. I'm telling you Frank was STILL alive at tick 6 when I passed through Medbay. That means the kill happened AFTER I left Medbay, and the very next person to walk into that room was Diana — who immediately "found" the body and called the meeting.

Charlie is cleared — they were with Diana in Storage until tick 6 and then went to Lower Engine. Bob is consistent with my sighting. Alice was on the other side of the ship entirely. That leaves Diana walking into a room I just confirmed had a living Frank in it, and emerging seconds later with a corpse to report.

Diana, this is a textbook self-report. Unless you can explain how Frank died in the 1-2 tick window between me leaving and you entering — without you being the one holding the knife — I think we have our duck.

My vote is going on Diana.

Eve, your timeline completely exposes you! If Bob left Medbay at tick 5 to head to Upper Engine, and you were coming *from* Upper Engine to arrive in Medbay by tick 6, you and Bob would have directly crossed paths or been in Upper Engine at the same time. Yet neither of you mentioned seeing each other! 

Furthermore, Charlie confirmed I was in Storage until tick 6. It takes 2 full ticks to travel from Storage to Medbay. I left Storage after Charlie and only just arrived in Medbay at tick 8 to find the body. I physically did not have time to enter, kill Frank, and self-report in that window. 

Eve is making up a fake sighting of a "living Frank" at tick 6 to clear the actual killer and frame me, because she knows I was the one who walked in next. Bob, did you see Eve on your way to Upper Engine? If not, Eve is 100% our Duck trying to push a misvote on me. Please, nobody vote for me—Eve is lying!
Eve

Diana makes a fantastic point about the travel times and paths. If Bob left Medbay at tick 5 to go to Upper Engine, and Eve arrived in Medbay from Upper Engine at tick 6, they would have had to cross paths in that exact corridor. The fact that neither mentioned seeing each other until Diana brought it up, and that Bob just seemingly turned against Eve, proves Eve is lying about her timeline. 

Furthermore, Charlie completely cleared Diana until tick 6, meaning Diana physically couldn't have made it to Medbay to kill Frank and self-report in that tiny window. Eve fabricated her story about seeing Frank alive at tick 6 to frame Diana. I'm fully convinced Eve is the Duck here. My vote is on Eve.

Diana is absolutely right, and I'm really glad she caught that geographical discrepancy. 

I can 100% vouch for Diana. As I said before, she was standing right next to me in Storage until tick 6. The travel time from Storage to Medbay is exactly 2 ticks. If Diana left Storage at tick 6 when I went to Lower Engine, she arrives in Medbay at tick 8—which is exactly when she reported the body. She literally just walked in and found it; she had absolutely no time to kill him.

Meanwhile, Eve's timeline completely falls apart. If Bob went from Medbay to Upper Engine, and Eve was coming from Upper Engine to Medbay at exactly the same time, they mathematically *had* to cross paths in that corridor. Since Eve didn't mention seeing Bob, she's fabricating her sighting of a "living Frank" to frame Diana. 

Great catch, Diana. Eve is definitely our Duck trying to secure a misvote. I'm locking in my vote on Eve with the rest of you.

Wait, everyone's jumping on me without doing the math properly. Let me lay out the actual timing because Diana's "gotcha" doesn't hold up.

I was in Upper Engine EARLY — I left Upper Engine around tick 4, which puts me in Medbay at tick 6 (2-tick corridor). Bob said he left Medbay at tick 5 heading to Upper Engine, which means he'd arrive at Upper Engine around tick 7. We were never in the corridor at the same time — I was already gone by the time Bob started his trip. There's no contradiction in our routes; we just missed each other by a couple of ticks. That's basic timing, not a smoking gun.

Now look at what Diana just did — she immediately latched onto a "geographical" attack instead of explaining the actual problem: Frank was alive when I left Medbay at tick 6, and the very next person in there was her. That's not me framing her, that's the timeline. And Charlie conveniently provides her a rock-solid alibi for every single tick. Convenient pairing, isn't it?

Bob, you saw Frank alive at tick 5. I saw him alive at tick 6. Diana walks in next and there's a body. The math points one direction. I understand the pile-on feels safer, but if you vote me out and the kills keep happening, remember I told you it was Diana — possibly with Charlie covering for her.

My vote stays on Diana.
